create_ontology_term_from_curie: create an OntologyTerm from a CURIE string like CLO:0000001 using from_curie
create_ontology_terms_from_curies: create a list of OntologyTerm objects from multiple CURIE strings using from_curies
convert_ontology_term_to_proto: convert an OntologyTerm to a protobuf message using the to_proto method
create_ontology_term_from_proto: create an OntologyTerm from a protobuf message using from_proto
get_ontology_curie: get the CURIE string representation of an OntologyTerm using the ontology_curie property
